# BlazeBinary golden wire vectors.
#
# Shared by the Swift tests (Tests/BlazeBinaryTests/GoldenVectorTests.swift)
# and the C tests (c/tests/test_blaze_binary.c). Both implementations must
# encode each value to exactly these bytes and decode these bytes back to
# exactly this value. The expected bytes were written by hand from the wire
# rules in c/README.md, not generated by either implementation.
#
# Formats:
#   ok     <type> <value> <hex bytes>
#   err    <type> <hex bytes> <truncated|invalid>
#   strict <type> <hex bytes>      Swift accepts, C rejects as invalid (non-canonical input)
#
# <type>: u8 u16 u32 u64 int bool schema
# "schema" value is the schema version followed by a u8 payload: <version>:<u8>
# Hex "-" means an empty buffer.

ok u8 0 00
ok u8 1 01
ok u8 42 2a
ok u8 127 7f
ok u8 128 80
ok u8 254 fe
ok u8 255 ff

ok u16 0 0000
ok u16 1 0001
ok u16 255 00ff
ok u16 256 0100
ok u16 4660 1234
ok u16 65535 ffff

ok u32 0 00000000
ok u32 1 00000001
ok u32 255 000000ff
ok u32 65535 0000ffff
ok u32 305419896 12345678
ok u32 4294967295 ffffffff

ok u64 0 0000000000000000
ok u64 1 0000000000000001
ok u64 81985529216486895 0123456789abcdef
ok u64 18446744073709551615 ffffffffffffffff

ok int 0 00
ok int 1 02
ok int -1 01
ok int 63 7e
ok int -64 7f
ok int 64 8001
ok int -65 8101
ok int 127 fe01
ok int 128 8002
ok int -128 ff01
ok int 300 d804
ok int -300 d704
ok int 1000000 80897a
ok int 9223372036854775807 feffffffffffffffff01
ok int -9223372036854775808 ffffffffffffffffff01

ok bool 0 00
ok bool 1 01

ok schema 2:42 fe022a
ok schema 127:255 fe7fff

err u8 - truncated
err u16 - truncated
err u16 01 truncated
err u32 010203 truncated
err u64 01020304050607 truncated
err int - truncated
err int 80 truncated
err int ffff truncated
err int ffffffffffffffffffff invalid
err int 8080808080808080808080 invalid
err bool 02 invalid
err bool ff invalid

strict int 8000
strict int ffffffffffffffffff7f
